newsitem.title: FRANCE: World motor vehicle output up 2.3 pct in 1996 - OICA.
newsitem.headline: World motor vehicle output up 2.3 pct in 1996 - OICA.

text.p: Motor vehicle production worldwide rose 2.3 percent in 1996 to 50.8 million vehicles, the Paris-based International Organization of Motor Vehicle Manufacturers (OICA) said on Tuesday.
It said car production rose 2.5 percent to 37.4 million from 1995, while light commercial vehicle output rose 4.2 percent to 10.9 million.
Heavy commercial vehicle production fell 8.6 percent.

Broken down by region, vehicle production rose 3.3 percent in Europe to 17.5 million, fell 0.1 percent in the Americas -- including a 1.5 percent drop in Canada, Mexico and the United States -- to 17.0 million, and rose 3.7 percent in Asia-Oceania to 16.2 million, the OICA said in a statement.
